dashboard.label: SOC L1 Threat Monitoring & Triage Dashboard
dashboard.description: Real-time security operations dashboard for Windows Security, Sysmon, PowerShell, and Network Telemetry. Designed for Tier 1 SOC analysts to rapidly detect, correlate, and triage emerging threats.

search.query: index=blue host=$host_filter$ | stats count AS value
index=blue host=$host_filter$ EventCode=4625 | stats count AS value
index=blue host=$host_filter$ EventCode=4740 | stats count AS value
index=blue host=$host_filter$ EventCode=4720 | stats count AS value

index=blue host=$host_filter$ EventCode=4104 | eval Script=coalesce(ScriptBlockText,Message) | where match(Script,"(?i)FromBase64String|EncodedCommand|DownloadString|IEX|Invoke-Expression|ExecutionPolicy Bypass|WindowStyle Hidden") | stats count AS value

index=blue host=$host_filter$ EventCode=3 | eval Source_IP=coalesce(SourceIp,SourceAddress) | eval Destination_IP=coalesce(DestinationIp,DestinationAddress) | eval Destination_Port=coalesce(DestinationPort,dest_port) | stats dc(Destination_Port) AS Unique_Ports by Source_IP Destination_IP | where Unique_Ports>=10 | stats count AS value

panel.title: Top Brute Force Sources (Event ID 4625 Threshold Breach)

search.query: index=blue host=$host_filter$ EventCode=4625 | eval Source_IP=coalesce(IpAddress,Source_Network_Address) | eval Target_User=coalesce(TargetUserName,Account_Name,user) | where isnotnull(Source_IP) AND Source_IP!="-" | stats count AS Failed_Attempts values(Target_User) AS Targeted_Accounts earliest(_time) AS First_Seen latest(_time) AS Last_Seen by Source_IP host | where Failed_Attempts>=5 | eval Severity=case(Failed_Attempts>=20,"High",Failed_Attempts>=10,"Medium",true(),"Low") | convert ctime(First_Seen) ctime(Last_Seen) | table First_Seen Last_Seen Source_IP host Targeted_Accounts Failed_Attempts Severity | sort - Failed_Attempts

index=blue host=$host_filter$ (EventCode=1 OR EventCode=11) | eval File_Path=coalesce(TargetFilename,Target_File_Name,Image,image) | where match(File_Path,"(?i)\\(temp|appdata|downloads|public|desktop|programdata)\\") AND match(File_Path,"(?i)\.exe$") | eval Activity_Type=if(EventCode=1,"Execution (Event 1)","Creation (Event 11)") | eval User_Account=coalesce(User,user,"Unknown") | table _time host Activity_Type User_Account File_Path CommandLine | sort - _time | head 20

panel.title: Security Events by Tactic / Use Case

search.query: index=blue host=$host_filter$ (EventCode=4625 OR EventCode=4720 OR EventCode=4740 OR EventCode=4104 OR EventCode=1 OR EventCode=3 OR EventCode=11) | eval Category=case( EventCode=4625,"Authentication Failures", EventCode=4720 OR EventCode=4740,"Account Modifications", EventCode=4104,"PowerShell Activity", EventCode=1 OR EventCode=11,"Process / File Activity", EventCode=3,"Network Connections", true(),"Other") | stats count AS Events by Category | sort 0 - Events
index=blue host=$host_filter$ (EventCode=4625 OR EventCode=4720 OR EventCode=4740 OR EventCode=4104 OR EventCode=1 OR EventCode=3 OR EventCode=11) | timechart span=15m count AS Events

panel.title: Recent SOC L1 Triage Stream
panel.description: Live event stream prioritized for analyst triage. Rows display high-fidelity indicators across authentication, process, and file telemetry.

search.query: index=blue host=$host_filter$ (EventCode=4625 OR EventCode=4720 OR EventCode=4740 OR EventCode=4104 OR EventCode=1 OR EventCode=3 OR EventCode=11) | eval Detection=case( EventCode=4625,"Failed Logon (4625)", EventCode=4720,"New Account Created (4720)", EventCode=4740,"Account Lockout (4740)", EventCode=4104,"PowerShell Script Block (4104)", EventCode=1,"Process Creation (Sysmon 1)", EventCode=3,"Network Connection (Sysmon 3)", EventCode=11,"File Creation (Sysmon 11)", true(),"Other Telemetry") | eval Account=coalesce(TargetUserName,SubjectUserName,User,user,"N/A") | table _time Detection host Account EventCode | sort 0 - _time | head 100
